title: Grab and Move softlocking its trigger key when window is foreground
author: Enderlessss

status.label: Needs focused evidence
status.detail: The intermittent stuck modifier cannot yet be tied to a repeatable foreground application or Grab and Move configuration.

next_action.label: Request stuck-key reproduction details
next_action.reason: Ask for the exact activation configuration, foreground application, and recovery behavior from the next occurrence.

judgment.rationale: The failure is potentially serious but intermittent; the missing trigger configuration and foreground application prevent a targeted investigation.
evidence: The reporter observes Alt and Win key-down events becoming unavailable while key-up events still register.
The problem usually appears around full-screen games but no specific application or exact reproduction sequence is known.
The report does not state the configured Grab and Move activation shortcut or whether disabling the module immediately restores normal input.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact trigger configuration and observations from the next occurrence.

actions.label: Request stuck-key reproduction details

comment.body: When this happens again, please record the foreground application or game and whether it is using exclusive full screen, borderless full screen, or windowed mode. Also provide your exact Grab and Move activation shortcut and settings, whether the activation key was held while focus changed, and whether disabling Grab and Move or exiting PowerToys immediately restores Alt/Win key-down events. A fresh bug report generated immediately after the failure would help correlate the keyboard-hook state.
